summary: A smoother first run: Mission Control stays open, and Claude asks for your email right in the chat.
notes: The first time you run launchpad, Mission Control opens and stays open. Before, two commands starting together could close it.
On a free build, Claude asks for your email in the chat and confirms it with the 6-digit code right there.
If launchpad can't build your app yet, like a Capacitor app, your free build isn't used up. It stays yours for another app.
Google Play apps get a card for getting your builds onto your phone, and Expo iOS apps get the iPhone one.
Claude tells you when a newer launchpad is out, so you're not stuck on an old version.

beta.summary: Every card shows one clear way to do it, and new versions arrive as a proper update window.
notes: Each to-do shows the quickest way first; other ways sit under one fold, each marked as an alternative.
A card launchpad can do itself says so, with one Do it button.
New versions open a window with the release notes and Update now, Later or Skip this version.
A newer update is never hidden behind an older notice.
Buys through a test checkout: you are not charged.
